content_json.caution:
다음 분은 복용하지 마세요. 이 약 또는 대두유, 콩, 땅콩에 과민증 환자, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이, 심한 증상의 신부전 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마세요.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수유부, 미숙아, 유아, 소화성궤양, 만성궤양성대장염, 국한성대장염 등의 위장질환, 심장·순환기계기능 장애, 신장장애, 저단백혈증, 고지단백혈증, 당뇨병성고지질혈증 및 췌장염 등 지방대사 이상 환자 또는 지질성 유제를 신중히 투여해야 하는 환자, 지방과부하로 특별한 위험이 예상되는 환자, 혈전성 소인이 있는 환자는 약사와 상의하세요.

en.title: Maxone Plus Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E and B1 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, and in old age; to relieve peripheral circulatory disturbance and menopausal shoulder and neck stiffness, numbness of the hands and feet, and cold hands and feet; to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (lower back pain, shoulder stiffness, etc.); and for beriberi, eye fatigue, and muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
en.usage:
Adults and children aged 12 years and older: take 1 capsule at a time, 2 times daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 12 months of age; severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or have any of the following: premature infants, infants; gastrointestinal disorders such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional colitis; cardiac or circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinemia; disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or conditions requiring careful use of lipid emulsions; conditions at particular risk from fat overload; a predisposition to thrombosis.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before using together with oral contraceptives containing estrogen, anti-aldosterone agents, triamterene, or intravenous lipid preparations. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea or black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhea, constipation, rash, redness, nausea, vomiting, loose stools, red spots, asystole (cardiac arrest), reduced central nervous system function, dermatitis, odor in sweat or breath, hair loss, restlessness, menstruation starting earlier than expected, gradually heavier menstrual flow, or prolonged bleeding occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 1 to 2 times daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hereditary conditions such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving to children, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Consult a pharmacist before taking together with levodopa.

If hypersensitivity reactions such as rash or itching occur, though rare, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist. Loss of appetite, stomach (upper abdominal) discomfort, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea may occasionally occur.

en.title: Magcell Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamin E in old age, to relieve peripheral circulatory disturbance and menopausal shoulder and neck stiffness, numbness of the hands and feet, and cold hands and feet, and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
en.usage:
Adults and children aged 12 years and older: take 1 capsule at a time, 2 times daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 12 months of age; severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or have any of the following: premature infants, infants; gastrointestinal disorders such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional colitis; cardiac or circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinemia; disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or conditions requiring careful use of lipid emulsions; a predisposition to thrombosis; hypersensitivity or past hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before using together with oral contraceptives containing estrogen, anti-aldosterone agents, triamterene, or intravenous lipid preparations. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea or black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhea, constipation, rash, redness (flushing), red spots, cardiac arrest, reduced central nervous system function, dermatitis, odor in sweat or breath, hair loss, restlessness, vomiting, menstruation starting earlier than expected, gradually heavier menstrual flow, or prolonged bleeding occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Lovital Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, and in old age, and to relieve peripheral circulatory disturbance and menopausal shoulder and neck stiffness, numbness of the hands and feet, and cold hands and feet.
en.usage:
Adults and children aged 8 years and older: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 3 months of age.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or have any of the following: infants under 1 year of age; premature infants, infants; hyperoxaluria (excess oxalate excreted in the urine); disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or conditions requiring careful use of lipid emulsions; conditions at particular risk from fat overload; a predisposition to thrombosis (blocked blood vessels); folic acid deficiency; hypersensitivity or past hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting laboratory test values. When giving to children, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Do not take together with levodopa. Consult a pharmacist before using together with oral contraceptives containing estrogen or intravenous lipid preparations.

If stomach discomfort, constipation, rash, redness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, menstruation starting earlier than expected, gradually heavier menstrual flow, or prolonged bleeding occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Trigel Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, stomach bloating, indigestion from overeating, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and sour belching.
en.usage:
Adults: take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times daily, swallowing quickly.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; receiving dialysis; hypermagnesemia; hyperphosphatemia; constipation; intestinal stenosis (narrowing); acute appendicitis; women within the first 3 months of pregnancy; children under 7 years of age.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or have any of the following: past hypermagnesemia or magnesium deficiency; past kidney disorder or kidney disease.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take together with tetracycline antibiotics. en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins D and B1 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, growth periods, and in old age, and to prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets.
en.usage:
Adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis (an inflammatory disease of unknown cause affecting the whole body); kidney disease; hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 12 months of age; kidney stones; severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or have any of the following: premature infants, infants; cardiac or circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinemia; taking cardiac glycosides; past kidney stones.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before taking together with anti-aldosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea or black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a pharmacist.
